The bundles are tightly packed and appear to contain multiple garments of various colors and patterns.
The plastic wrapping is clear, showing the contents through the mesh of the straps.
No individual garments are visible; only the bundled contents are shown.
The seller's text claims 'UK first-grade clothing' and 'quality, stylish, and affordable'.
